tests: driver formulas (time savings: staff x hours x weeks x rate, adoption, recapture, haircut)

source.title: The Total Economic Impact of Tealium CDP
source.how_opened: PDF downloaded and text-extracted; table 'Productivity Lift' (Ref D1-D5, Dt, Dtr), p.18
source.caveat: Forrester Total Economic Impact study, commissioned by the vendor (vendor-favourable by design)

mapping_notes: Forrester states labor efficiency as a percent of a 12-person team at $120,000 burdened cost. We express it as hours: 40 hours x 50 weeks = 2,000 hours, so $60 per hour reproduces $120,000. The 2,000-hour year is our choice, not Forrester's.
The efficiency ramp 21% / 23% / 25% is carried by adoption_by_year = efficiency / 25% = 84 / 92 / 100, with hours saved per person per week set at the Year 3 value (25% x 40 = 10).
Productivity recapture 80% is the study's own assumption (source: Assumption) and maps to recapture_pct.

expected.rounding: Forrester prints whole dollars; arithmetic is exact

tolerance.why: published whole-dollar rounding; the arithmetic is exact (recomputed in recompute.py)
